scope: local dashboard and platform extraction; working tree changes concurrently
note: No live credentials tested. Test-path disposition uses reviewed test context, never only filename. Fingerprints must match before reusing these dispositions.

actions.action: Exclude the whole generated runtime directory from Git and every source/archive/package path. Contains SQLite database, WAL/SHM sidecars and video preview. Current root ignore covers *.sqlite but does not cover all sidecars or preview assets. Do not infer these are sanitized just because tests generated them.
actions.verification: Git ignore now covers platform/server/data/ and all database sidecars; git ls-files returned no runtime/data entries. Source archive builder rejects any tracked data directory. Final archive still needs inspection.

actions.action: Remove nonempty API key default; require user-provided configuration and disable engine when absent. If a credential owner confirms it is private/live, rotate via their normal process. No network validation performed.
actions.verification: Executable key default removed; local search initializer disables Pexels and supplies no key.

actions.action: Remove upstream recovery-email fallback. Require ADMIN_RECOVERY_EMAIL or leave recovery disabled; ensure a fresh install cannot route recovery to the upstream organization.
actions.verification: Main platform and Mission Control now use empty recovery fallback; local account identifier domain is not a recovery destination. Verified staged blobs in index-review-dispositions.json.

actions.action: Upstream signing-secret placeholder remains. Installer must generate a fresh instance secret and fail closed if this default reaches runtime. This is a default-security issue, not a leaked secret.
actions.verification: init-settings.py generates token_hex(32), exclusive private file; wsgi.py requires absolute settings path and rejects missing/short/upstream default secret before SearXNG import.

actions.action: Replace production mailbox identity/user fallbacks with explicit local account configuration. Keep mail integration disabled until configured. Review duplicated mission-control defaults too.
actions.verification: Both mailbox/service.ts copies have no upstream mailbox identity/user defaults; verified staged blob fingerprints in index-review-dispositions.json.

actions.action: Google Fonts literal removed in refreshed staged blob. Current SHA-256 recorded in index-review-dispositions.json. No network validation performed.
Generated PNGs removed from index; root ignore now platform/*/data/. Refreshed immutable index scan found no runtime/data paths. Final archive review is separate.
